title: 悠米 · 魔法书午觉
description: 奶油色魔法猫悠米趴在漂浮的蓝色厚书上打哈欠，蓝紫尾巴卷成小弧。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayons with broken edges, scribbled fill and visible warm paper tooth
art_direction.palette: cream fur, powder blue, periwinkle, pale gold, soft mint
art_direction.composition: Yuumi from League of Legends, the recognizable small magical cream-colored cat with enormous soft blue eyes, pale-blue inner ears, blue-purple accents at the paws and long fluffy tail, and a tiny gold ornamental mark on her forehead. She is a cute quadruped cat, not an anthropomorphic person. Curled contentedly belly-down across her large floating blue-and-gold magic book, mouth open in a sweet sleepy yawn, one rounded paw dangling lazily over the book edge, other paws naturally tucked beneath her. The tail curls upward in a single soft arc. The thick open book hovers only a few inches above a little round rug; its pages have simple abstract pastel smudges, absolutely no writing or letters. A tiny pale green plant and a single cushion in the background. Wide soothing paper margins, full tail and both book covers inside the frame. Crayon fur tufts and scribbled paper texture, not smooth plush 3D.

visual_qa.method: six-image compressed JPEG contact sheet review, 1280x900
